system.text:
This character is evil, and everyone knows it. Little children run away crying, dogs bark maniacally. This character, and all of his cohorts within his Presence gain +2D to Intimidate or Interrogate. If the malevolent character has other characters helping him Intimidate, each character grants an additional helping die over what they would normally give. Only one effect may be used at a time.

Type: Dt (die trait). Cost: 6 pts.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 313
